ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 82% of the visible surface area, contrasted with low-intensity black/dark grey pixels concentrated on the perimeter and focal spots (approx 18%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous jagged boundary along the trailing edge and covers the distal tips. Distinct circular black 'donut' spots (6-8 visible) are distributed semi-symmetrically. Yellow-brown intensity clusters are localized in the lower medial regions near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex angle approximately 45 degrees; vertical depth relative to lobe peaks is significant.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations. The boundary exhibits constant pixel-level oscillation with jagged peaks ranging 5-15 pixels from the mean edge line, particularly dense on the inner half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory on the upper lobe margins, tapering into sharp, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular dark rings (10-20 pixels in diameter) distributed across both lobes, likely healed barnacle attachment sites. Right distal tip shows a high-intensity white cluster of raised pixels indicating active barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Clearly defined dark linear streaks. Three parallel vertical lines on the left lobe; three elongated, curved diagonal rake marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the mid-sections of both lobes; visible cluster of calcified barnacle shells on the far right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellow-ochre biological staining originating near the peduncle and radiating into the lower ventral lobes.
